cat << 'EOF' > parse_mjcf.py
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, json

tree = ET.parse('panda_fixed.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

# defaults
default_joint = {'axis':[0,0,1], 'range':[-2.8973,2.8973], 'type':'hinge'}
finger_joint = {'axis':[0,1,0], 'range':[0,0.04], 'type':'slide'}

wb = root.find('worldbody')

joints=[]
bodies=[]
def walk(b, depth=0):
    name=b.get('name')
    if name: bodies.append((name,depth))
    for j in b.findall('joint'):
        cls=j.get('class')
        base = finger_joint if cls=='finger' else default_joint
        jtype = j.get('type', base['type'])
        axis=[float(x) for x in j.get('axis').split()] if j.get('axis') else base['axis']
        rng=[float(x) for x in j.get('range').split()] if j.get('range') else base['range']
        joints.append({'name':j.get('name'),'type':jtype,'axis':axis,'ctrlrange':rng})
    for cb in b.findall('body'):
        walk(cb, depth+1)

for b in wb.findall('body'):
    walk(b)

# actuators
acts=[]
for a in root.find('actuator'):
    jn=a.get('joint') or ('tendon:'+a.get('tendon') if a.get('tendon') else None)
    cr=a.get('ctrlrange')
    if cr: cr=[float(x) for x in cr.split()]
    else: cr=[-2.8973,2.8973]  # panda class default
    acts.append({'name':a.get('name'),'joint':jn,'ctrlrange':cr})

# sites
sites=[s.get('name') for s in wb.iter('site')]
# equality
eqs=[e.tag for e in (root.find('equality') or [])]

print("BODIES:", bodies)
print("JOINTS:", json.dumps(joints, indent=1))
print("ACTS:", json.dumps(acts))
print("SITES:", sites)
print("EQ:", eqs)
print("NHINGE:", sum(1 for j in joints if j['type']=='hinge'))
print("NSLIDE:", sum(1 for j in joints if j['type']=='slide'))
EOF

import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('mjcf.xml')

def jtype(t):
    return {mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_HINGE:'hinge', mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_SLIDE:'slide',
            mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_BALL:'ball', mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_FREE:'free'}[t]

joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    n=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, i)
    t=m.jnt_type[i]
    axis=[float(x) for x in m.jnt_axis[i]]
    lim=m.jnt_range[i].tolist() if m.jnt_limited[i] else [None,None]
    joints.append({'name':n,'type':jtype(t),'axis':axis,'ctrlrange':lim})

acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    n=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, i)
    trn=m.actuator_trntype[i]
    tid=m.actuator_trnid[i,0]
    if trn==mujoco.mjtTrn.mjTRN_JOINT:
        jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT, tid)
    elif trn==mujoco.mjtTrn.mjTRN_TENDON:
        jn='tendon:'+mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_TENDON, tid)
    else: jn=None
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[i].tolist() if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else [None,None]
    acts.append({'name':n,'joint':jn,'ctrlrange':cr})

sites=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE, i) for i in range(m.nsite)]
bodies=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, i) for i in range(m.nbody)]

# free joint bodies (graspable)
grasp=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    if m.jnt_type[i]==mujoco.mjtJoint.mjJNT_FREE:
        b=m.jnt_bodyid[i]
        grasp.append(mujoco.mj_id2name(m, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, b))

print("BODIES:", bodies)
print("SITES:", sites)
print("NEQ:", m.neq)
print("GRASP:", grasp)
print("JOINTS:", json.dumps(joints))
print("ACTS:", json.dumps(acts))
json.dump({'joints':joints,'acts':acts,'sites':sites,'bodies':bodies,'grasp':grasp}, open('parsed.json','w'))
EOF
